blocks.en: Section 0: Introduction & Container Types

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈671〉 的目的：為固體和液體口服劑型的包裝系統建立功能性標準
blocks.en: Understand the purpose of USP <671>: to establish functional standards for packaging systems for solid and liquid oral dosage forms

blocks.zh: 掌握水蒸氣透過率（Moisture Vapor Transmission Rate, MVTR）的概念及其對藥品穩定性的重要性
blocks.en: Understand the concept of Moisture Vapor Transmission Rate (MVTR) and why it matters for drug product stability

blocks.zh: 識別並區分多種單元容器（multiple-unit）與單位劑量容器（unit-dose）的測試方法分類（Methods 1–8）
blocks.en: Identify and distinguish the test method classifications for multiple-unit and unit-dose containers (Methods 1–8)

blocks.zh: 理解分類系統（Classification System）如何協助藥師和機構重新包裝者選擇適當容器
blocks.en: Understand how the Classification System helps pharmacists and institutional repackagers select appropriate containers

blocks.zh: 掌握乾燥劑方法（Desiccant Methods）與水方法（Water Method）的差異與適用場景
blocks.en: Understand the differences between the Desiccant Methods and the Water Method, and when each applies

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: USP 〈671〉 的定位：這是一個功能性測試章節（Performance Testing），專門評估包裝系統的「屏障性能」——也就是說，包裝能多好地保護藥品不受環境中水分和光線的影響。
blocks.en: Positioning of USP <671>: This is a functional (performance) testing chapter that evaluates the "barrier performance" of a packaging system, that is, how well the package protects the drug product from moisture and light in the environment.

blocks.zh: 兩大目標使用者：
blocks.en: Two main target users:

blocks.zh: 製造商/包裝商：需要知道自己產品的 MVTR 數值，用於穩定性測試和上市申請（NDA/ANDA）
blocks.en: Manufacturers/packagers: need to know the MVTR values of their products for stability testing and marketing applications (NDA/ANDA)

blocks.zh: 藥師/機構重新包裝者：需要知道如何選擇適當的容器來分裝原廠包裝的藥品
blocks.en: Pharmacists/institutional repackagers: need to know how to select suitable containers for dispensing products from the original manufacturer's packaging

blocks.zh: Moisture Vapor Transmission Rate (MVTR, 水蒸氣透過率)：水蒸氣在單位時間內穿透包裝系統的速率，單位通常是 mg/day/container 或 mg/day/cavity。
blocks.en: Moisture Vapor Transmission Rate (MVTR): The rate at which water vapor passes through a packaging system per unit time, usually expressed in mg/day/container or mg/day/cavity.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你有一個保溫飯盒和一個普通塑膠袋。你用兩種容器分別裝餅乾，一週後哪個還是脆的？保溫飯盒就像「高屏障」包裝——它阻擋了空氣中的水分進入，讓餅乾保持乾燥。
blocks.en: Imagine you have an insulated lunch box and an ordinary plastic bag. You store crackers in each. After a week, which ones are still crisp? The lunch box is like a "high-barrier" package: it keeps moisture in the air out, so the crackers stay dry.

blocks.zh: MVTR 就是在量化：「每天有多少毫克的水蒸氣能穿透這個容器壁進入裡面？」數值越低，包裝屏障越強，藥品越安全。
blocks.en: MVTR quantifies exactly this: "How many milligrams of water vapor pass through the container wall into the inside each day?" The lower the value, the stronger the barrier and the safer the drug product.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 〈671〉 vs 〈659〉 vs 〈1671〉 的分工：
blocks.en: Division of roles among <671>, <659> and <1671>:

blocks.zh: 〈659〉：定義容器類型（密封容器、緊閉容器等），提供術語定義
blocks.en: <659>: defines container types (tight containers, well-closed containers, etc.) and provides terminology definitions

blocks.zh: 〈671〉：提供實際測試方法和數值標準（本章）
blocks.en: <671>: provides the actual test methods and numerical criteria (this chapter)

blocks.zh: 〈1671〉：提供 MVTR 數據如何應用於 SODF 重新包裝等値性論證的指導
blocks.en: <1671>: provides guidance on how MVTR data are applied in SODF repackaging equivalence justifications

blocks.zh: 三個章節彼此互補，閱讀 〈671〉 時應同時參考其他兩章。
blocks.en: The three chapters complement one another; when reading <671>, refer to the other two as well.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 客戶的藥品是口服固體錠劑，委外給藥局分裝成小包裝。藥局應使用 〈671〉 中哪個部分的方法來選擇適當容器？
blocks.en: A CDMO client's product is an oral solid tablet that is outsourced to a pharmacy for repackaging into small packs. Which part of <671> should the pharmacy use to select an appropriate container?

blocks.zh: MVTR 和藥品有效期限有什麼關係？為什麼屏障性能差的包裝可能導致藥品提前失效？
blocks.en: What is the relationship between MVTR and drug product shelf life? Why might poor barrier packaging cause a product to fail early?

blocks.zh: Table 1 — Moisture Vapor Transmission Test Methods 測試方法總覽表
blocks.en: Table 1 — Moisture Vapor Transmission Test Methods Overview

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 方法體系架構
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Structure of the Method System

blocks.zh: 〈671〉 的八個方法可以用兩個維度來理解：
blocks.en: The eight methods in <671> can be understood along two dimensions:

blocks.zh: 目的維度：測量 MVTR 數值（Methods 1–4）vs 分類容器等級（Methods 5–8）
blocks.en: Purpose dimension: measuring MVTR values (Methods 1–4) vs classifying container grades (Methods 5–8)

blocks.zh: 填充物維度：乾燥劑法（放吸濕劑，量重量增加）vs 水法（放水，量重量減少）
blocks.en: Fill dimension: desiccant methods (a desiccant is placed in the container and the weight gain is measured) vs the water method (water is placed in the container and the weight loss is measured)

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑法和水法的測試條件「相反」但等效：乾燥劑法在 40°C/75% RH（高濕）下測量水分進入；水法在 40°C/25% RH（低濕）下測量水分流出，兩者的壓力差相同。
blocks.en: The desiccant and water methods use "opposite" but equivalent test conditions: the desiccant method measures moisture ingress at 40°C/75% RH (high humidity), while the water method measures moisture egress at 40°C/25% RH (low humidity); the vapor pressure difference is the same in both.

blocks.zh: 想像你要測試一個水桶有多防漏：
blocks.en: Imagine testing how leak-proof a bucket is:

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑法：把乾燥劑放進桶裡，把桶放在潮濕環境中，觀察乾燥劑吸了多少水（水從外進入）
blocks.en: Desiccant method: put desiccant in the bucket, place the bucket in a humid environment, and observe how much water the desiccant absorbs (water enters from outside)

blocks.zh: 水法：把水放進桶裡，把桶放在乾燥環境中，觀察水少了多少（水從內流出）
blocks.en: Water method: put water in the bucket, place the bucket in a dry environment, and observe how much water is lost (water escapes from inside)

blocks.zh: 兩種方法測的是同一個「漏洞」，只是方向不同。
blocks.en: Both methods measure the same "leak"; only the direction differs.

blocks.zh: 誰需要用哪個方法？
blocks.en: Who needs which method?

blocks.zh: 原廠製造商：主要使用 Methods 1–4 取得 MVTR 數值，用於穩定性申報
blocks.en: Original manufacturers: mainly use Methods 1–4 to obtain MVTR values for stability filings

blocks.zh: 藥局/重新包裝者：主要使用 Methods 5–8 進行分類，確認容器等級符合原廠要求
blocks.en: Pharmacies/repackagers: mainly use Methods 5–8 for classification, to confirm that the container grade meets the original manufacturer's requirements

blocks.zh: 這個區別非常重要——分類（Classification）≠ 精確 MVTR 值，分類只是確認是否符合「tight」或「well-closed」等等級門檻。
blocks.en: This distinction is very important: Classification ≠ a precise MVTR value. Classification only confirms whether the container meets the threshold for grades such as "tight" or "well-closed".

blocks.zh: Method 3 是針對什麼類型的包裝設計的？為什麼它的稱重時間間隔比 Method 2 短很多？
blocks.en: What type of packaging is Method 3 designed for? Why is its weighing interval much shorter than that of Method 2?

blocks.zh: 為什麼水法（Method 4）使用的是 40°C/25% RH 而不是 40°C/75% RH？這個設計的邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does the water method (Method 4) use 40°C/25% RH rather than 40°C/75% RH? What is the logic behind this design?

blocks.zh: Moisture Vapor Transmission — Introduction 水蒸氣透過測試介紹
blocks.en: Moisture Vapor Transmission — Introduction

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — ASTM D7709 基礎
blocks.en: Key Concepts — ASTM D7709 Fundamentals

blocks.zh: ASTM D7709 (水蒸氣透過率測試標準)：USP 〈671〉 的乾燥劑法直接基於 ASTM D7709，這是業界廣泛認可的重量法（gravimetric method）——用重量變化來推算水蒸氣透過速率。
blocks.en: ASTM D7709 (standard test method for water vapor transmission rate): The desiccant methods in USP <671> are based directly on ASTM D7709, a widely recognized gravimetric method that uses weight change to calculate the water vapor transmission rate.

blocks.zh: 重量法的邏輯：容器內有乾燥劑，水蒸氣從外部穿透容器壁進入，被乾燥劑吸收。容器整體重量增加的速率 = MVTR。
blocks.en: Logic of the gravimetric method: the container holds desiccant, water vapor passes from the outside through the container wall and is absorbed by the desiccant. The rate of weight gain of the whole container = MVTR.

blocks.zh: 三種屏障等級定義：
blocks.en: Definitions of the three barrier grades:

blocks.zh: Low-barrier (低屏障)：MVTR > 1.0 mg/cavity/day（用 Method 3）
blocks.en: Low-barrier: MVTR > 1.0 mg/cavity/day (use Method 3)

blocks.zh: High-barrier (高屏障)：MVTR < 1.0 mg/cavity/day（用 Method 2）
blocks.en: High-barrier: MVTR < 1.0 mg/cavity/day (use Method 2)

blocks.zh: Ultra-high barrier (超高屏障)：MVTR < 0.01 mg/cavity/day（用 Method 2，但需更多空腔）
blocks.en: Ultra-high barrier: MVTR < 0.01 mg/cavity/day (use Method 2, but with more cavities)

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — 天平靈敏度要求
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — Balance Sensitivity Requirement

blocks.zh:
天平靈敏度要求計算：
最小重量增加 ≥ 60 × 天平精度

例：天平解析度 = 0.1 mg
  稱量不確定度 = 0.1 × 3 = 0.3 mg
  最低重量增加 = 0.3 / 5% = 6 mg

  即：每個稱量時間點間隔的重量增加
  必須 ≥ 6 mg（= 60 × 0.1 mg）

若包裝屏障很高（重量增加很慢），
需要更高解析度的天平或更長的稱量間隔。
blocks.en:
Balance sensitivity requirement calculation:
Minimum weight gain ≥ 60 × balance precision

Example: balance resolution = 0.1 mg
  Weighing uncertainty = 0.1 × 3 = 0.3 mg
  Minimum weight gain = 0.3 / 5% = 6 mg

  That is: the weight gain between
  weighing time points must be ≥ 6 mg (= 60 × 0.1 mg)

If the package barrier is very high (weight gain is very slow),
a higher-resolution balance or a longer weighing interval is needed.

blocks.zh: 測試條件 40°C/75% RH 正是 ICH Q1A 規定的加速穩定性測試條件。這不是巧合——USP 特意把 MVTR 測試條件設計成與加速穩定性測試一致，這樣包裝在穩定性研究中看到的降解，就能直接與 MVTR 數據關聯起來。
blocks.en: The test condition of 40°C/75% RH is exactly the accelerated stability testing condition specified in ICH Q1A. This is not a coincidence: USP deliberately designed the MVTR test conditions to match accelerated stability testing, so that degradation seen in the package during stability studies can be directly correlated with MVTR data.

blocks.zh: 就像你用同樣的「極端天氣」來測試雨傘和車漆，方便直接比較不同材料的性能。
blocks.en: It is like testing both an umbrella and car paint under the same "extreme weather", which makes it easy to compare the performance of different materials directly.

blocks.zh: 天平選擇的實務考量：對於超高屏障的鋁箔/鋁箔泡殼（foil-foil blister），水蒸氣幾乎無法穿透，每個稱量間隔的重量增加可能只有 0.01–0.1 mg 等級。此時需要微克級天平（microbalance），而且需要使用更多空腔（>10 個，最多 30 個）來累積足夠的訊號。
blocks.en: Practical considerations in balance selection: For ultra-high-barrier foil-foil blisters, water vapor barely penetrates, and the weight gain per weighing interval may be only on the order of 0.01–0.1 mg. A microbalance is then required, along with more cavities (>10, up to 30) to accumulate enough signal.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼方法的靈敏度設計如此重要——稱量不確定度必須遠小於你要測量的信號。
blocks.en: This is why the sensitivity design of the method is so important: the weighing uncertainty must be far smaller than the signal you want to measure.

blocks.zh: 一個包裝系統每個稱量間隔預計增加 3 mg 重量，你需要至少什麼解析度的天平？
blocks.en: A packaging system is expected to gain 3 mg per weighing interval. What is the minimum balance resolution you need?

blocks.zh: 為什麼稱量時間間隔的溫度/濕度控制很重要？如果每次稱量前不做平衡處理，數據會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why is temperature/humidity control important during the weighing interval? What problems would the data have if the packages were not equilibrated before each weighing?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: USP 〈671〉 提供塑膠包裝系統的功能性測試標準，核心指標是 MVTR（水蒸氣透過率）
blocks.en: USP <671> provides functional testing standards for plastic packaging systems; the core metric is MVTR (moisture vapor transmission rate)

blocks.zh: 測試方法分兩大類：MVTR 定量測量（Methods 1–4）和容器等級分類（Methods 5–8）
blocks.en: The test methods fall into two categories: quantitative MVTR measurement (Methods 1–4) and container grade classification (Methods 5–8)

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑法與水法的測試壓力差相同，但方向相反：前者在高濕環境測重量增加，後者在低濕環境測重量減少
blocks.en: The desiccant and water methods use the same vapor pressure difference but opposite directions: the former measures weight gain in a high-humidity environment, the latter measures weight loss in a low-humidity environment

blocks.zh: 天平靈敏度要求：稱量不確定度必須 < 每時間點重量變化量的 5%（最低重量增加 ≥ 60× 天平精度）
blocks.en: Balance sensitivity requirement: the weighing uncertainty must be < 5% of the weight change per time point (minimum weight gain ≥ 60× balance precision)

blocks.zh: 測試條件 40°C/75% RH 與 ICH 加速穩定性測試條件一致，便於直接關聯穩定性數據
blocks.en: The 40°C/75% RH test condition matches the ICH accelerated stability testing condition, making it easy to correlate directly with stability data
